description: This file implements a custom markdown parser that extracts headers and section line ranges, mimicking tree-sitter structures without using the actual tree-sitter library.

classes.name: MockNode
classes.description: Interface to mimic tree-sitter node structure with start and end positions and text.

classes.name: MockCapture
classes.description: Interface to mimic tree-sitter capture structure, associating nodes with capture names.

methods.name: parseMarkdown
methods.description: Parses markdown content to identify headers and compute section line ranges, returning captures compatible with tree-sitter.

methods.name: formatMarkdownCaptures
methods.description: Formats captured headers and sections into a string representation, filtering by minimum section length.
